disclaimer: Scenario results are illustrations built from editable assumptions. They are not forecasts of real demand, prices or profit.

festival.label: Festival and seasonal events
festival.note: Multipliers live on each event row below (editable per event). Choose events instead of a slider.
festival.source_note: Hand-curated events table; dates from the `holidays` package where available. Assumption, not a measurement.

weather.label: Weather shock
weather.source_note: Calibrated so severity 67 gives x0.80 demand, matching the 'Heavy monsoon' preset row (evt_047). Assumption, not a measurement.

fuel.label: Fuel price
fuel.source_note: Calibrated so +20% gives x0.94 demand and x1.08 rates and costs (evt_048). Transport costs pass through. Assumption, not a measurement.

currency.label: Local currency vs USD
currency.unit: change in local currency (%); negative = weaker
currency.source_note: A weaker local currency makes the destination cheaper for USD travellers. Calibrated to evt_049 and evt_050 within rounding. Assumption, not a measurement.

visa.label: Visa and entry policy
visa.unit: change in ease of entry (%); negative = harder
visa.source_note: Calibrated so +33 gives x1.10 demand (evt_051). Assumption, not a measurement.

disruption.label: Disruption (strikes, closures, unrest)
disruption.source_note: Calibrated so severity 100 gives x0.45 demand (evt_052). Assumption, not a measurement.

demand_to_rate.label: Rate response to demand
demand_to_rate.note: Rates move by demand multiplier to this power (0 = rates ignore demand, 1 = fully proportional).

sell_pass_through.label: Sell price follows market rates
sell_pass_through.note: Share of a rate move the agency passes into sell prices (power on the rate multiplier).

cost_follows_rate.label: Supplier cost follows rates
cost_follows_rate.note: Share of a market rate move that reaches supplier net cost.

occupancy_at_peak.label: Occupancy in the busiest historical month
occupancy_at_peak.note: Proxy only. Used to turn the demand index into an occupancy estimate.

occupancy_ceiling.label: Occupancy ceiling
occupancy_ceiling.note: Demand above this is turned away and can spill to similar destinations.

spill_share.label: Displaced demand that moves elsewhere
spill_share.note: Rest is assumed lost to the wider market.

spill_cap_pct.label: Largest uplift a neighbour can receive (%)
spill_cap_pct.note: Keeps spillover from producing implausible jumps.

presets.expect: Demand dips, costs and rates rise.

presets.label: INR −5%
presets.expect: Demand up slightly, USD rates and costs down.
presets.detail: A weaker rupee makes India cheaper for USD travellers.

presets.label: EUR +5%
presets.expect: Demand dips, USD rates and costs up.
presets.detail: A stronger euro makes Italy dearer for USD travellers.

presets.label: Regional disruption
presets.expect: Large demand drop, some spillover to similar destinations.
